# Text { #anylumino.Text }

```python
Text(
    value='',
    description='',
    placeholder='',
    disabled=False,
    continuous_update=True,
    layout=None,
    style=None,
)
```

Single-line text input control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type     | Description                                                           | Default    |
|-------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `''` |
| description | optional | Label shown next to the control. | `''` |
| placeholder | optional | Text shown while the input is empty. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| continuous_update | optional | Whether Python receives updates while the user is typing or dragging. | `True` |
| layout | optional | ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing. | `None` |
| style | optional | ipywidgets style object or style dictionary. | `None` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [continuous_update](#anylumino.Text.continuous_update) | Update the value as the user types. If False, update on submission, e.g., pressing Enter or navigating away. |
| [disabled](#anylumino.Text.disabled) | Enable or disable user changes |
| [style](#anylumino.Text.style) | An instance trait which coerces a dict to an instance. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [on_submit](#anylumino.Text.on_submit) | (Un)Register a callback to handle text submission. |

### on_submit { #anylumino.Text.on_submit }

```python
Text.on_submit(callback, remove=False)
```

(Un)Register a callback to handle text submission.

Triggered when the user clicks enter.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type   | Description                                                   | Default    |
|----------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| callback |        | Will be called with exactly one argument: the Widget instance | _required_ |
| remove   |        | Whether to unregister the callback                            | `False`    |
